
The {{nihongo|Ono family|小野氏}} are the priests of [[Hinomisaki Shrine]]. They descend from {{ill|Ame-no-Fuyukinu|it|Ame-no-Fuyukinu|ja|天之冬衣神|zh|天之冬衣神|qid=Q48744862|lt=Ame-no-Fuyukinu's}} son {{ill|Kiyotake Toyohiko no Mikoto|qid=Q135491392}} brother of [[Ōkuninushi]] and often intermarried with the [[Izumo clan]]. <ref>[[:ja:小野尊光|Takamitsu Ono]]『小野家譜』(Histoire de la famille Ono)（{{ill|Historiographical Institute of the University of Tokyo|en|Historiographical Institute of the University of Tokyo}}, 1875）</ref>
